title: Finance Minister Urges Tax Department to Prioritize Common People
summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman directed the Income Tax department to work for the benefit of common people, stating that it is their job to take care of assets when they are encroached. She also criticized the 'laidback' nature of government offices and urged the I-T department to prioritize citizen needs. The Finance Minister spoke at the NDTV Business Leadership Awards 2026.

framing.center: Centrist coverage foregrounded the criticism of government offices' 'laidback' nature, emphasizing the need to prioritize citizen needs. They also mentioned the Finance Minister's direction to the I-T department.
